title: causalaime: combining approximate inverse model explanations and the Peter-Clark algorithm for unified global feature explanation in healthcare
keywords: causal and correlational relationships of explanatory variables
core_idea: Introduce causalaime, a framework that integrates approximate inverse model explanations (AIME) with the Peter-Clark causal discovery algorithm to suppress multicollinearity and enable global visualization of feature signs and class-specific contributions; by using either model outputs (ŷ) or true labels (y) as input, the framework unifies model-dependent and data-driven global feature importance.
tldr: A unified framework (causalaime) that combines AIME and the Peter-Clark algorithm to provide sign-based, class-specific global feature explanations and reconcile model-dependent and data-driven importance in healthcare.
